description: Shared definitions for the ARSIA protocol schema suite.

rfc3339-ms-utc.description: ARSIA timestamp (ARSIA-Core.md §4.1.3): an RFC 3339 date-time in UTC with the Z designator and exactly three fractional digits. The pattern carries the ARSIA profile: years 0001-9999, months 01-12, days 01-31, hours 00-23, minutes and seconds 00-59 (no leap second). The day MUST exist in that month of that year; a pattern cannot express that, so the format states it and a validator that asserts formats checks it.

oauth-scope.description: OAuth 2.0 scope value (RFC 6749 §3.3; ARSIA-Core.md §6.1): one or more scope tokens of visible ASCII characters other than the double quote and the backslash, separated by exactly one space (U+0020), with no leading or trailing space.

sha256-hex.description: SHA-256 digest as 64-character lowercase hex string.

capability-name-wildcard.description: Capability identifier (2+ segments) or trailing wildcard pattern.

payload-type.description: Payload type / action identifier with dot segments and optional slash subpath.

retention-override.description: Retention override of a PURGE (ARSIA-State.md §3.2.2): the operator's explicit determination that values still within retention are erased. REQUIRED in a PURGE within retention, as determined by the implementation from stored state. Records that a determination was stated; it does not establish that the determination exists or is legally correct.

reason.description: The justification for erasing values still within retention (e.g. 'gdpr_art17_erasure').

determination_ref.description: A reference by which the operator's documented determination can be retrieved (e.g. a case or document identifier). The operator keeps it retrievable for at least as long as the state_purge record is retained.
